approved_definition_context: EuclideanSpace real (Fin n) is real n-dimensional Euclidean space with its standard Borel measurable space. Fin n indexes coordinates from zero through n-1.
The orthogonal group is full real O(n), both determinant signs, with its matrix Borel structure. Measure.haarMeasure(top : PositiveCompacts G) is canonical normalized full-group Haar probability.

Measure.restrict is restriction to the displayed set. Scalar multiplication of measures uses extended nonnegative real scalars. Measure.bind integrates the displayed probability kernel against its input measure. Measure.real B is the extended measure of B converted to a real number.

multivariateGaussian mean m covariance C is the pushforward of canonical stdGaussian by z -> m + Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (CFC.sqrt C) z. Matrix inverse is the standard totalized matrix inverse. The covariance interpretation holds for positive semidefinite C.

Real division and inverse are totalized at zero. Natural powers have natural exponents. sSup is the real least-upper-bound operator on the displayed event-gap set. MeasurableSet refers to Borel measurability on the Euclidean carrier.
